profile.businessSummary: Redtape Limited, demerged from Mirza International, is a leading fashion and lifestyle brand offering footwear, apparel, and accessories, known for its quality and trendy designs.

news.title: Redtape's Board of Directors will meet on November 4, 2026, to consider and approve Q2 and half-year financial results. The trading window for designated persons remains closed until 48 hours after the declaration of the financial results.
Redtape Ltd clarified no undisclosed info impacting share price/volume was withheld. The volume change in Redtape shares attributed to market conditions and factors.

Redtape gains as shareholders approve Shuja Mirza's reappointment as MD, driving diversification and growth. Q1 FY27 net profit rose 15.2% YoY but fell 36.3% QoQ to Rs 44.5 crore; sales rose 3.7% YoY but dropped 28.8% QoQ.
Redtape shareholders reappoint Rashid Ahmed Mirza as Director and Shuja Mirza as MD for 5 years from April 2027. Rashid Mirza remains Executive Chairman post age 70; both are father-son duo.

Redtape Ltd held its 5th AGM on August 25, 2026, via video conferencing, chaired by Mr. Rashid Ahmed Mirza. Resolutions, including financial statements and appointments, were approved; e-voting results will be disclosed post-scrutinizer's report.
RedTape's Q1 FY27 revenue stands at Rs 480 crore, PAT at Rs 47 crore. Investor deck highlights focus on profitability over volume; stock weakness persists despite record profit.
Redtape Ltd's board approved unaudited Q1 FY26 results, reviewed by the Audit Committee. Impact of Sept 2025 income tax searches on Q1 results remains unclear; financials on website.
Redtape's Q1 net profit rose 15.3% to ₹44.5 crore; revenue grew 4% to ₹481.3 crore. EBITDA surged 94% to ₹83.6 crore with margin improving to 17.36% from 9.28% YoY.
Redtape Limited's Q1 EBITDA rose to 735M rupees from 431M YoY. EBITDA margin expanded significantly to 15.3% from 9.3% YoY.
RedTape's Q1 revenue rises to 4.8B INR from 4.64B INR YoY. Growth indicates improved top-line performance for RedTape.

notes.text: In Jun '26, revenue is ₹496 crore and profit is ₹44 crore, a net margin of 9.0%. In Jun '25 those figures were ₹473 crore, ₹39 crore, and 8.2%. The latest full year, 2026, has revenue of ₹2,552 crore and profit of ₹241 crore. The year before, revenue was ₹2,172 crore and profit was ₹170 crore.
